payload.summary: Ownership contract: owns PRD F3 and F4 query parsing, filtering, selection, and ordering. Support only --since, --by, --map, --provenance, --limit; intersect filters before limiting; accept settled time/actor/map/badge forms; require positive limits; default newest 10; retain newest N with bounded collection, then render-order oldest to newest by ts-seq-id; undated incomplete rows remain eligible, sort after dated rows, and tie by ticket ID. Focused acceptance stays here: every filter alone and intersected, empty results, invalid inputs with focused usage/help pointer, filter-before-limit, 0/1/10/>10, explicit limits, same-time ties, and multiple undated rows. CLI prose/rendering belongs to t71vpsjs.
